Card Q&A.a: Yes, all of your other Digimon with [Knightmon] in their text will be prevented from leaving the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: When multiple of my other Digimon with [Knightmon] in their text would leave the battle area simultaneously due to my opponent's effects, if I activate this Digimon's [All Turns] effect and place it as 1 of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card, are all of my other Digimon with [Knightmon] in their text prevented from leaving the battle area?

Effect: [All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Knightmon] in their texts would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by placing this Digimon as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card, they don't leave.
Inherited Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
